summary: One blocking finding will be applied: generated skill artifacts are not the runtime location for draft-gate per-step prompt text.

items.title: Generated skill artifact target contradicts dispatcher architecture
items.rationale: The finding matches verified architecture: sdd-forge.flow is a thin dispatcher and draft-gate text is loaded from src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md through next-action, not inlined into generated skill artifacts.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules names src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md as the step instruction source; spec-review.md cites src/flow/lib/get-step-instructions.js and src/upgrade.js behavior.
